sourceTitle: Extracts from the Diary of William Bray
description: "Extracts from the Diary of William Bray" by William Bray is a historical account crafted during the late 18th and early 19th centuries. This collection provides an intriguing glimpse into the daily life and social engagements of a notable figure in English history, covering a significant period from 1756 to 1800, with additional notes until 1832.
